card.name: Young child development milestones
card.fires_on: Function words and punctuation inside passages about a young child's age or abilities, such as early milestones, kindergarten readiness, or a toddler's weight. It fires on the small word after the child detail, not on the child word itself.

modes.label: Milestone lists
modes.description: Pronouns, commas and verbs in a list of what a small child has achieved or can do.
modes.example: He spoke his first sentence at nine months old, he crawled on time,<< he>> used a wheelchair for the first time at

modes.label: Toddler age and weight
modes.description: Blank spot after an infant's age, where a weight or grade standard comes next.
modes.example: a 19-month old child weighing<< >>12 kg was seen in the hospital

card.writes: It pushes toward toddler and crawling words, so the model expects talk about young children.
card.plain: It lights up in text about a small child's age and what they can do, and it expects toddler-type words next.
